nodes.name: FOODTURE European Food LCI Database
nodes.geography: European food market with selected imported systems and Latin American cases
nodes.sector: Agriculture, aquaculture, fisheries, processed foods, packaging, transport and consumption

nodes.name: AGRIBALYSE
nodes.sector: Agriculture and food; public documentation refers to 2,516 finished food products

nodes.name: ecoinvent database
nodes.sector: Multi-sector; v3.12 public release page lists agriculture, chemicals, fuels, metals, electricity, forestry, textiles, transport, pulp and paper, batteries and electronics.

nodes.name: Product Environmental Footprint method
nodes.geography: European Union method with wider voluntary use
nodes.sector: Goods and services across product groups; product-category rules may refine the method

nodes.name: LIFE ECO FOOD CHOICE
nodes.geography: France, Germany, Netherlands and Spain with European harmonisation objective
nodes.sector: Food products, diets and environmental labelling

relationships.evidence: FOODTURE reports integration of leading datasets including AGRIBALYSE in its emerging food LCI framework.
relationships.constraints: Source licences, release versions and transformations must be retained.
relationships.validation_question: Publish record-level lineage and change logs.

relationships.evidence: FOODTURE identifies ecoinvent among leading datasets integrated into its infrastructure.
relationships.constraints: Open-access commitments must respect ecoinvent redistribution rights.
relationships.validation_question: Separate licensed backgrounds from shareable foreground data.

relationships.evidence: The project states that the database will align with PEF and cover whole food value chains.
relationships.constraints: Final method profile and reference package are not yet released.
relationships.validation_question: Publish the applicable EF/PEF version with every dataset.

relationships.evidence: The two projects announced co-development of an LCI methodology intended as an umbrella PEFCR for food.
relationships.constraints: The joint method is still under development.
relationships.validation_question: Track the final jointly released document and governance.
